conditions: An object declared with the groupshared storage specifier in the dated draft.
limitations: This is a storage-duration description. It has no implication about initialization, memory synchronization, visibility, or dispatch-wide lifetime.

triggers: An upstream correction, new dated draft, changed serving bytes, or conflicting scoped result.

statement: The November 10, 2026 HLSL working draft describes an object declared with the groupshared storage specifier as living from the start to the end of its thread group’s execution.
